paraphrase: OPEN analyst formulation; attribution DEFERRED: At least some linguistic activities have activity-specific purposes and rules for competent moves, and learning those rules is part of understanding some expressions used in them. This specificity alone does not entail that claims made in the activity are insulated from evidence or reasons shared outside it.
